hotels.title: Riviera Nayarit Beachfront Luxury at Omni Pontoque Resort Punta de Mita
hotels.description: Set on a private peninsula in Punta de Mita, this refined beachfront retreat pairs Pacific Ocean views with direct access to white-sand shores and the calm waters of Banderas Bay. Days drift between three swimming pools, a full-service spa and rounds on the Jack Nicklaus-designed Litibú Golf Course nearby. Dining spans oceanfront Mexican fare at Pescador, wood-fired specialities at Bahia and Japanese-inspired plates at Siki. Beyond the resort, guests can visit the Marietas Islands for hidden beaches and snorkelling, or browse the galleries, boutiques and seafood restaurants of Sayulita
